disorders-categories.alt: Ten boxes, one per DSM-5-TR category, with its representative disorders: neurodevelopmental (ADHD, autism spectrum disorder); schizophrenia spectrum; depressive (major depressive, persistent depressive); bipolar (I and II); anxiety (specific phobia, agoraphobia, panic, social anxiety, generalized anxiety); obsessive-compulsive and related (OCD, hoarding); dissociative (dissociative amnesia, dissociative identity disorder); trauma- and stressor-related (PTSD); feeding and eating (anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa); personality (Clusters A, B and C).
